## Supplemental Table1
```{r}
s1 <- readxl::read_xlsx(fs::path(dir_result, "T1.Continuous PFAS and HCC.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]` = paste0(round(exp(estimate), 2), " [", 
                               round(exp(conf_low), 2), ",",
                               round(exp(conf_high), 2),"]"),
         `P-Value` = signif(p_value, 2))%>% 
  select(type, pfas_name, `Odds Ratio[95%CI]`,`P-Value`)%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "pfas_name",
              names_from = "type",
              values_from = c(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]`, `P-Value`)) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]_Overall \n(n = 474)`))
# writexl::write_xlsx(s1, fs::path(dir_result, "Supplemental Tables/Table S1. PFAS and HCC.xlsx"))
```

## Supplemental Table 2
```{r s2}
s2 <- readxl::read_xlsx(fs::path(dir_result, "single_categorical_exposure_analysis.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(pfas_name = case_when(pfas_name == "4H_PFBA" ~ "4H-PFBA",
                               pfas_name == "10_2_FToH" ~ "10:2 FTOH",
                               pfas_name == "2_aminohexafluoropropan_2_ol" ~ "2-Aminohexafluoropropan-2-ol",
                               pfas_name == "Me_PFHxA" ~ "MePFHxA",
                               TRUE ~ pfas_name),
         ) %>% 
    mutate(type = case_when(type == "All Races" ~ "Overall \n(n = 474)",
                          type == "Japanese American" ~ "Japanese American \n(n = 182)", 
                        type == "Latino"~ "Latino \n(n = 160)"))%>%
  mutate(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]` = paste0(round(odds_ratio, 2), " [", 
                               round(exp_ci_low, 2), ",",
                               round(exp_ci_high, 2),"]"),
         `P-Value` = signif(p.value, 2),
         `P trend` = signif(p_trend, 2))%>% 
  select(type, pfas_name, `Odds Ratio[95%CI]`,`P-Value`, `P trend`, term)%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("pfas_name", "term"),
              names_from = "type",
              values_from = c(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]`, `P-Value`, `P trend`)) %>%
  mutate(term = paste(substr(term, (nchar(term)-8), nchar(term)-1) %>% toTitleCase(), substr(term, nchar(term), nchar(term)))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(. == "1 [NA,NA]", "1", .)))

# writexl::write_xlsx(s2, fs::path(dir_result, "Supplemental Tables/Table S2. Dose response.xlsx"))
```

## Supplemental Table S3
```{r}
s3 <- readxl::read_xlsx(fs::path(dir_result, "PFAS and SNP interaction.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(pfas_name = case_when(pfas_name == "4H_PFBA" ~ "4H-PFBA",
                               pfas_name == "10_2_FToH" ~ "10:2 FTOH",
                               pfas_name == "2_aminohexafluoropropan_2_ol" ~ "2-Aminohexafluoropropan-2-ol",
                               pfas_name == "Me_PFHxA" ~ "MePFHxA",
                               TRUE ~ pfas_name)
         ) %>% 
    mutate(type = case_when(type == "All races" ~ "Overall \n(n = 474)",
                          type == "Japanese American" ~ "Japanese American \n(n = 182)", 
                        type == "Latino"~ "Latino \n(n = 160)"))%>%
  mutate(name = case_when(grepl("Interaction", name_plot) ~ "SNP * PFAS Interaction",
                            grepl("PFAS", name_plot) ~ "PFAS Main Effect",
                            TRUE ~ "SNP Main Effect"),
           name = factor(name, levels = c("SNP * PFAS Interaction", "SNP Main Effect", "PFAS Main Effect"))) %>%
  mutate(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]` = paste0(round(odds_ratio, 2), " [", 
                               round(exp_ci_low, 2), ",",
                               round(exp_ci_high, 2),"]"),
         `P-Value` = signif(p.value, 2))%>% 
  select(type, pfas_name, snp, genes, name, `Odds Ratio[95%CI]`,`P-Value`)%>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("type","pfas_name","snp", "genes"),
              names_from = "name",
              values_from = c(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]`, `P-Value`)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("pfas_name","snp", "genes"),
              names_from = "type",
              values_from = c(`Odds Ratio[95%CI]_PFAS Main Effect`:`P-Value_SNP * PFAS Interaction`)) %>%
  select(pfas_name:genes, contains("SNP * PFAS Interaction_Overall"),contains("SNP Main Effect_Overall"), contains("PFAS Main Effect_Overall"), contains("SNP * PFAS Interaction_Japanese"),contains("SNP Main Effect_Japanese"), contains("PFAS Main Effect_Japanese"),contains("SNP * PFAS Interaction_Latino"),contains("SNP Main Effect_Latino"), contains("PFAS Main Effect_Latino"))
  
writexl::write_xlsx(s3, fs::path(dir_result, "Supplemental Tables/Table S3. PFAS and SNP.xlsx"))
```
